import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Extract hour from time column
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)

# Aggregate total sales per hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum().reindex(range(24), fill_value=0).reset_index()
hourly_sales.columns = ['hour', 'total_sales']

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(x='hour', y='total_sales', data=hourly_sales, marker='o', color='b')
plt.title('Total Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Hour (24-hour format)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(range(0, 24))
plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
